grammar.0.note: Exam type, scores, duration and fees differ by provider (e.g. Goethe, telc, ÖSD, TestDaF-Institut and the Integrationskurs exam). Always check the provider's site for the latest official information.
grammar.1.note: A little but regular practice works better than practising once in one long stretch. Keep going with this app's „Wiederholen“ list every day.
grammar.2.note: If you get stuck, don't stop — rephrase with other words. Examiners look at how you use the language, not perfection.
quiz.9.prompt: Put the sentence in order: “If I don't pass, I will try again.”
